text: Hb stable 112 -> 114. Discharge planned 16:00 after repeat Hb if unchanged.
Cellulitis receding, marked border 4 cm smaller. Afebrile 30 h. Suitable for Sjukhus hemma with IV cloxacillin pump. Patient keen to go home.
COPD exacerbation, improving slowly. Weaned off oxygen this morning, SpO2 88-90% on air (target 88-92). Intermittent RR 23. Could be considered for home care if stable through the day.
Heart failure responding. Weight down 3.1 kg. Switched to oral furosemide. Wife at home. Suitable for Sjukhus hemma.
Pneumonia day 4, stable 48 h on air. Plan oral switch tomorrow. Suitable for Sjukhus hemma or discharge in 1-2 days.
Patient asks about going home early. Lives in Trelleborg.
Pneumonia day 3, stable. Could be considered for home care; patient not yet asked.
Home visit: IV ceftriaxone 1x daily (nurse visit). Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.

78-year-old woman admitted via ED with 3 days of productive cough, fever and breathlessness. CXR: right lower lobe consolidation. CRP 186. On arrival: RR 24, SpO2 93% on air, HR 104, temp 38.9, BP 124/70, alert (NEWS2 6). Started IV cefotaxime 1 g x3. History: hypertension (amlodipine), type 2 diabetes (metformin). Previous admission Feb 2025 for left lower lobe pneumonia requiring 2 L/min oxygen for 3 days. No COPD. No known drug allergies. Lives with husband in Lomma, independent in ADL. No treatment limitations.

Clinically improving. Afebrile > 24 h, SpO2 95-96% on air, RR 16, CRP 112. Assessed suitable for Sjukhus hemma: stable > 24 h, IV cefotaxime can continue via portable elastomeric pump, husband at home, patient consents. Plan: transfer home tomorrow 09:00, bloods day 5, escalate per monitoring plan.
Transferred home 09:00. Wearable patch, tablet and kit K-07 set up. Patient and husband instructed in chat, video and when to call. First home visit completed, pump connected.
Home visit 09:10: pump changed. Patient feeling better, walked to the mailbox. Eating more. Blood glucose 8.4.
Home visit 07:05: pump changed. Slept poorly because of cough, otherwise feels okay. Vitals within plan.
Home visit: IV furosemide twice daily. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.
Home visit: IV cloxacillin via portable pump. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.
Pneumonia resolving. Afebrile 72 h, CRP 24. Switched to oral amoxicillin yesterday. Can be handed over to the primary-care mobile team (mobil narsjukvard) when capacity allows.
Home visit: Subcutaneous LMWH, oral apixaban start planned. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.

71-year-old man with COPD GOLD 3 admitted with exacerbation. Arterial blood gas: pH 7.33, pCO2 7.4 kPa - hypercapnic respiratory failure, also documented 2024. Target SpO2 88-92%. Use NEWS2 SpO2 Scale 2. Prednisolone 40 mg, nebulisers.
Stable on air with SpO2 88-91%, which is his usual range. Suitable for Sjukhus hemma. Do not give oxygen without physician review. Wife at home.
Daughter visits daily. Patient oriented to person and place, mild memory impairment at baseline.
Pneumonia improving on oral antibiotics. Medically ready for step-down. Note: lives alone, fall at home in 2024. Check home support before handover to primary care.
Home visit: IV ceftriaxone 1x daily. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.
Transferred home with wearable patch. Patient has psoriasis plaques near the sensor site; adhesion has been poor before.
Permanent AF with resting rate 95-108 is her baseline. Custom alert set: HR > 125 sustained 1 h.
Home visit: IV antibiotics, long course. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.
Home visit: IV benzylpenicillin via pump. Patient comfortable, eating and drinking. Vitals within plan. No new concerns.
